UserProfileData.title: User Profile and Links Data
UserProfileData.description: The complete profile, social links, stats, and auth details stored under a unique creator username

username.description: Unique, lowercase alphanumeric identifying slug chosen by the creator

passwordHash.description: Securely hashed password computed on save

profile.description: Nested visual profile containing custom theme config and bio metrics

links.description: Standard link entries or nested sublink coding profile groups

clicks.description: Map mapping individual link identifiers to total clicks and date-level analytics

/users/{username}.description: Stores scalable, persistent link-in-bio custom card profiles indexed by physical creator username
